title: Correct N magnitude
description: Essential: Student must state or derive N = (√3/3) mg.

title: Correct F magnitude
description: Essential: Student must state or derive F = (3/2) mg.

title: Correct f magnitude
description: Essential: Student must state or derive f = (√3/6) mg.

title: Force equilibrium for C
description: Important: Student must apply vertical force balance to sphere C (2N cos θ = mg) to relate N to the contact angle.

title: Geometry for contact angle
description: Important: Student must correctly determine the contact angle θ = 30° from the geometry of three equal-radius spheres.

title: Force equilibrium for A
description: Important: Student must apply horizontal and vertical force balance to body A (or B) to relate F and f to N and θ.

title: Friction not limiting check
description: Optional: Student may verify that the required frictional force f is less than or equal to μF, confirming static equilibrium is possible.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if force components (e.g., sin vs cos for N) are swapped or if directions in free-body diagrams are inconsistent.

title: Incorrect geometry/angle
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the contact angle θ is incorrectly found (not 30°), leading to wrong numerical results.

title: Missing force on A/B
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the normal force F on A omits the vertical component from N or if friction f is omitted.
